newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 85.00/05 vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 85.00/05 vs mark.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas at levels of 85.00 and 85.05 versus the mark on Tuesday, dealers in Madrid said.
The peseta has seen renewed weakness in recent sessions since the debate on Europe's single currency appeared to throw into doubt Spain's chances of being included in the first round, dealers said.
The central bank itself declined to comment, consistent with policy.
Dealers said the interventions, via third parties, were aimed at smoothing the peseta's fall.
At 0945 GMT, the peseta was at 84.94/97 to the mark after opening at 85.11/14.
